name: 24683-sharegpt-nemotron12b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine on one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. Seed static 24683.
workload: ShareGPT draw materialised to `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-nemotron12b.jsonl` by `configs/data/make-dataset.py`: 1000 rows, mean 223.1 prompt / 204.7 output tokens, prompt capped at 1024 tok. Each row carries `output_tokens_count` and the backend forces `ignore_eos`, so generation runs to exactly that length. `request_format: plain`, sampling `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A 12-billion-parameter chat assistant handling short multi-turn conversations for 256 concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2

# REQUIRED: this engine's config registry does not know `nemotron_h`, so the config
# resolves through transformers, which refuses the repo without this flag.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own `torch_dtype`, pinned so resolution needs no network.
dtype: bfloat16

# The request file is capped at 1024 prompt tokens and 2048 prompt+output by
# construction; the checkpoint's own value is 131072.
max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# PINNED AND LOAD-BEARING. Do not delete these as "the defaults": built in-process they
# fall through to the SchedulerConfig floors of 2048 and 128, the latter BELOW the 256
# concurrent streams declared here, which would silently cap the load.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: false
